mapper.insert: insert into nad_task_event (task_id, event_type, from_status, to_status, actor_user_id, note, created_at) values (#{taskId}, #{eventType}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{actorUserId}, #{note}, now())
mapper.select: select ev.id, ev.task_id, ev.event_type, ev.from_status, ev.to_status, ev.actor_user_id, ev.note, ev.created_at, su.nick_name as actor_name from nad_task_event ev left join sys_user su on su.user_id = ev.actor_user_id where ev.task_id = #{taskId} order by ev.id asc
